_comment: Add a _ before an option name to comment it out and it wont be added to the apworld
Using 'goal' as the name of an option let you override some of the generated goal parameters
goal.description: How to End your Randomized playthrough.

filler_traps._comment: Using values here let you set a 'recommended' filler_trap percentage or even a default percentage

description: Whether or not to include levels from World 5: All for One in the pool.
Only turn this on if you're playing the game in local multiplayer, as this world is not accessible in online play.
The total number of Park Token items that will be in the multiworld.
The total percentage of Park Tokens that will be required to beat the game.
The total number of worlds that must be completed (i.e. all 4 levels in the world beaten) to beat the game.
